```{=html}
<p>Code for plotting the effectiveness landscape of mutualisms adding isolines of equal effectiveness values.</p>
<p>Effectiveness landscapes are the two-dimensional representation of the possible combinations of the quantity and the quality of mutualistic services (seed dispersal, pollination) and with elevational contours representing isoclines of effectiveness. These representations can be 2D bivariate plots of multiplicative effects of any of the seed dispersal (SDE) or pollination (PE) effectiveness components.</p>
<p>We have addressed these components of mutualism effectiveness for the specific case of seed  dispersal mutualisms in:<br/>
<a href="http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1469-8137.2010.03402.x/full">Schupp, E.W., Jordano, P. &amp; Gomez, J.M. (2010). Seed dispersal effectiveness revisited: a conceptual review. New Phytol, 188, 333–353.</a></p>
<p>A number of people have asked me about the R code we used, and it is uploaded to <a href="https://github.com/pedroj/effectiveness">my github repository</a>. The page with additional explanation is <a href="http://pedroj.github.com">here</a>. Enjoy!</p>

```
